modules.name: Ollama
modules.tagline: A popular way to run AI models on your own computer
modules.description: Ollama runs AI language models with no internet and no account. The app keeps its own private copy and its models in your library folder, and it is installed automatically with your first Ollama model. Models you add here can read your installed library, just like the others.

modules.name: Qwen 2.5 0.5B (Ollama)
modules.tagline: Tiny and quick, for old computers
modules.description: Alibaba's smallest Qwen model through Ollama. Runs on almost anything; answers are short and simple. About 0.5 GB of memory.

modules.name: Qwen 2.5 1.5B (Ollama)
modules.tagline: Good answers on an ordinary laptop
modules.description: Alibaba's 1.5 billion parameter model through Ollama. A good balance for most computers. About 2 GB of memory.

modules.name: Llama 3.2 3B (Ollama)
modules.tagline: Better answers, needs a real computer
modules.description: Meta's 3 billion parameter model through Ollama. Clearly stronger; wants a laptop with 8 GB of memory or a Raspberry Pi 5. About 4 GB of memory.

modules.name: Qwen 2.5 7B (Ollama)
modules.tagline: The most capable; needs a strong computer
modules.description: Alibaba's 7 billion parameter model through Ollama. Best answers; wants 16 GB of memory for comfort, 8 GB at least.
